workflows.name: Cold Email Lead Generation Pipeline
workflows.purpose: On Apify run completion, fetches the dataset, filters leads against ICP and detects niche, checks Supabase suppression, generates OpenRouter personalization, mirrors leads to Supabase and pushes to Smartlead campaigns, then Slack-notifies.
workflows.reusable_components: Entire workflow is the reference implementation: Apify dataset fetch from webhook payload, ICP filter + niche detection code, Supabase suppression check, OpenRouter personalization call, Smartlead lead-push API pattern, Slack notify.

workflows.name: FlowOps · Phase 0 — Lead Generation (Apify → Smartlead + Reply→Slack)
workflows.trigger: cron: every 6 hours (sourcing branch) + /smartlead-reply (webhook, reply branch)
workflows.purpose: Earlier-gen lead engine: loops configured niches, scrapes each via Apify run-sync, maps to Smartlead lead schema, POSTs to campaign; separate branch receives Smartlead reply webhooks and posts to Slack.
workflows.reusable_components: Niche-config loop with splitInBatches, Apify→Smartlead field-mapping code, Smartlead add-leads endpoint call, Smartlead reply-webhook → Slack notify branch

workflows.name: FlowOps Backfill Personalization V2
workflows.purpose: Every 10 min, loops Smartlead campaigns, fetches leads with cursor persistence, calls Anthropic (tool-use) to generate 9 personalization variables per lead, validates keys, PATCHes the lead back into Smartlead, and Slack-alerts on failures.
workflows.reusable_components: Everything: Smartlead leads fetch + cursor-persist code, Anthropic tool-use personalization with 9-key validation, Smartlead lead-update call, failure summarization + Slack alert. This is the canonical personalization-backfill engine.

workflows.name: FlowOps Backfill Personalization
workflows.purpose: V1 monolith of the personalization backfill: single code node with hardcoded Smartlead + Anthropic API keys, 10 campaign IDs, niche labels, and the founder-tone 9-key personalization system prompt; fetches, personalizes, and updates leads inline. Superseded by V2. NOTE: live API keys are hardcoded in the code node.
workflows.reusable_components: The 9-key personalization system prompt (tone rules, niche labels, city/state pain references) and the campaign-ID/niche mapping — directly reusable in the cold-email engine; keys should be moved to credentials

workflows.name: Cold Email Lead Intake Pipeline
workflows.purpose: Receives a leads array via webhook, responds 200 immediately, splits, dedupes, normalizes fields in a code node, filters to has-email, and appendOrUpdates rows into a Google Sheet (doc 1c3nAyqgji..., tab Leads).
workflows.reusable_components: The whole thing: webhook intake → splitOut → removeDuplicates → field normalization code → has-email gate → Sheets appendOrUpdate is a ready-made lead-ingestion front door for a cold-email engine.

workflows.name: Daily Apify Niche Scrapes (FlowOps)
workflows.trigger: cron daily at hour 11 UTC (6 AM ET)
workflows.purpose: Daily schedule fires a code node that kicks off Apify niche scrape runs (lead sourcing for FlowOps).
workflows.reusable_components: Daily-cron → programmatic Apify actor kickoff from a code node — the seed of the automated daily lead-sourcing loop.

workflows.name: B30 Reply Pipeline
workflows.purpose: Smartlead EMAIL_REPLY webhook: parses reply, Claude classifies intent (POSITIVE_HIGH..SPAM, JSON with confidence + suggested reply), inserts reply row and handles unsubscribe suppression in Supabase (brutus schema), auto-sends Smartlead reply only if POSITIVE_HIGH & confidence>=0.90 & thread_position>=2, scrapes company site/news signals (Apify rag-web-browser + direct fetch), posts rich Slack card and stores thread ref back to Smartlead lead. Note: hardcoded Anthropic, Smartlead, Apify, and Supabase service-role keys live in code nodes.
workflows.reusable_components: Entire workflow is the cold-email reply engine: Claude JSON intent classifier prompt, auto-send guardrail logic, Supabase suppression handling, Smartlead reply-email-thread API call, Apify rag-web-browser research-signal enrichment, Slack Block Kit reply card

workflows.name: Qualification Call Booked — Slack Notification + Research
workflows.purpose: GHL appointment webhook → extracts lead/appointment data, looks up the lead's Smartlead custom fields (slack_message_ts/slack_channel) to find the original reply thread, and posts a Block Kit call card into that Slack thread (fallback channel C0AMW0J3X6X).
workflows.reusable_components: Smartlead lead lookup-by-email pattern; storing Slack thread_ts/channel in Smartlead custom fields for reply-thread continuity; Slack Block Kit call-card posting with thread fallback.

workflows.name: Cold Email Lead Generation Pipeline
services: smartlead.ai (payload built, push node not connected)
workflows.purpose: Apify run-finished webhook → fetches the run's dataset, filters leads by ICP (decision-maker titles, blocks role emails, company_size<200), normalizes fields into Smartlead lead schema, batches, builds Smartlead payload — final push node intentionally not connected ('Create a Smartlead campaign then connect the Push node').
workflows.reusable_components: Entire skeleton is a cold-email lead engine: Apify webhook→dataset fetch, ICP title/role-email/company-size filter, field normalization to Smartlead lead_list shape with settings (dont_email_unsubscribed_leads), batch splitting.

workflows.name: B01 — Hiring Ops Signal Scraper
workflows.purpose: Daily runs Apify Indeed scraper (misceres~indeed-scraper) across 5 ops-role queries with async start→poll→dataset-fetch, parses/filters postings for ops-hiring signals, dedupes and inserts into Supabase signals table, posts a Slack daily report.
workflows.reusable_components: Apify actor invocation with polling loop and dataset fetch (in-code, token inline); Supabase dedupe-then-insert signal storage; hiring-signal keyword filter; Slack daily report.

workflows.name: B22 — Smartlead Push
workflows.purpose: Brutus push webhook (responds 202 immediately) → validates contacts require smartlead_campaign_id/sequence_id, checks Supabase is_suppressed RPC per contact, groups allowed leads by campaign in batches of 100, POSTs to Smartlead campaigns/{id}/leads, writes send events + marks signals sent in Supabase, logs suppressed, Slack batch report.
workflows.reusable_components: Suppression check via Supabase RPC before send; campaign-grouped 100-lead batching; Smartlead add-leads API call; send-event ledger writes; async 202-then-process webhook pattern — this IS the push stage of a cold-email lead engine.

workflows.name: Smartlead → Slack: New Lead Notification
workflows.purpose: Receives a Smartlead event via webhook and posts a new-lead notification to Slack. Two nodes: Webhook → Slack.
workflows.reusable_components: Smartlead webhook intake → Slack notify pattern; directly reusable as the reply/interest notification tail of a cold-email engine.

workflows.name: B11 — Enrichment + Suppression
services: findymail/apollo/anymailfinder/hunter/millionverifier (waterfall — keys are PASTE_ placeholders, not wired)
workflows.purpose: Brutus pipeline stage: pulls pending signal_events from Supabase, marks them enriching, runs an email-enrichment waterfall (Findymail→Apollo→Anymailfinder→Hunter→MillionVerifier), persists results with suppression/no-email filtering, forwards ready contacts to B22 via /brutus-push, and posts a Slack report. Waterfall API keys are unfilled placeholders.
workflows.reusable_components: The whole thing: enrichment waterfall code node, Supabase signal_events state machine (pending→enriching→done/failed), suppression filter, webhook+hourly-sweep dual trigger, forward-to-next-stage handoff, Slack run report. Core building block for the cold-email lead engine — note keys must be filled.

workflows.name: Apify Rotation Dispatcher - 400 Leads/Day
workflows.purpose: Daily gate: checks Smartlead for >=5 ACTIVE-warmup mailboxes, then deterministically rotates 4 niche/city pairs (10 niches x 10 cities, day-of-year offset) and fires Apify google-maps-with-contact-details runs (100 places each) with ACTOR.RUN.SUCCEEDED/FAILED webhooks pointed at /apify-lead-pipeline.
workflows.reusable_components: Smartlead mailbox-health gate, deterministic niche/city rotation, Apify actor invocation with completion webhooks carrying niche/city context — the core of a cold-email lead-sourcing engine.

workflows.name: B22 — Smartlead Push
workflows.purpose: Receives lead batches (responds 202 immediately), validates/expands, runs Supabase RPC is_suppressed per lead, pushes allowed leads to Smartlead campaign /leads endpoint in batches of 100, writes send_events, marks signal events sent, logs suppressed leads, Slack summary.
workflows.reusable_components: Whole workflow: async 202-webhook intake, suppression check via Supabase RPC, batched Smartlead lead upload, send_events audit trail, suppressed-lead logging — purpose-built cold-email push infrastructure.
